Type: distressed wood wall mirror
Use: decorating a wall, reflecting light; bedroom, living room, entryway, above a dresser
Style: farmhouse, rustic, traditional
Materials: wood frame with distressed white paint, mirror glass
Colors: warm white, cream, hints of brown
Shape: tall rectangle with curved concave pagoda-like top shoulders, narrow molded frame, chipped edges, medium size, light
Feel: vintage, soft, charming
Goes with: natural wood, linen, soft pastels, white walls; farmhouse, cottage or rustic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Curved Vintage-Look Wood Frame Wall Mirror - 28-Inch Height, White
product.description: Straight lines are paired with graceful curves that peak at the top on this antique-style mirror. Distressed white paint on a hardwood frame adds more vintage charm. This mirror will look right at home in a classic style room. Antique-style shape and finish Made of glass and hardwood with distressed white finish 16"W x 1"D x 28"H Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
